newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's MEFF Jan-Nov trading volume up 17.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's MEFF Jan-Nov trading volume up 17.20 pct.

text.p: The Spanish futures market, MEFF, said on Tuesday that in the first eleven months of the year it traded 57.3 million contracts, representing a 17.2-percent increase over the same period one year ago.

Out of these contracts, 22.2 million were done in the fixed-income segment, up 52.8 percent from the previous year. The other 35.1 million contracts were in the share segment, where the activity rose a mere 2.13 percent.
Average daily volume was valued at 64 billion pesetas in fixed income from January to November and 1.58 billion pesetas for shares.
